Backup & Restore

Backup Files

Export your complete campaign as a JSON file. On iPhone or iPad, use Share / Save to Files if you want to place the backup directly in the Files app.

Restore Backup File

Select a JSON backup file from Files. Restoring replaces the campaign currently stored on this device after first creating a safety snapshot.

Manual Backups

Manual snapshots are saved inside the app when you export or when you press Create Manual Snapshot. The app keeps only the newest 12 manual snapshots.

Automatic Backups

Automatic snapshots are created before important saved data is replaced. The app keeps only the newest 12 automatic snapshots. Older automatic snapshots are removed automatically.
